_comment: This is a convenience lock, not real security, see README. Default password is 'starstream'. To set a new one, open any browser console and run: crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode('yourNewPassword')).then(b => console.log(Array.from(new Uint8Array(b)).map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join(''))), then paste the printed value into passwordHash below.
